title: [S-M43-01] Raise rehearsal/output QC to full technical conformance (loudness, true peak, clipping, sample rate, frame rate, resolution, 9:16 brand Reel)
prompt:
Source inspection of `scripts/real_media_rehearsal.mjs` and `scripts/real_media_smoke.mjs` (2026-10-31, main @ 7d56fef):

- The rehearsal renders H.264/AAC on a 1920x1080 solid color plate at 2 fps; no `loudnorm` filter is applied, and ffprobe collects codec names plus stream/format durations only.
- The completeness gate (S-M41-01) validates required streams and measured audio coverage — not loudness, true peak, clipping, sample rate, or frame rate.
- Therefore any claim of exactly -14.02 LUFS / 60 fps / 48 kHz is NOT evidence-backed by these scripts; only ~0.997/0.998/0.999 measured audio coverage for the 1800/2400/3000 s targets is.
- The smoke script renders the `brand_reel` at 1:1, whereas the canonical package requirement is a standalone 9:16 brand promo Reel.

## Scope (offline; no provider credentials; no publishing)

- [ ] Measure loudness honestly with FFmpeg's ebur128/loudnorm analysis pass (integrated LUFS, true peak dBTP, clipping count) and put those numbers, per artifact, into the rehearsal QC output — measured values printed, not constants
- [ ] Implement loudness normalization as a real post-render pass (measured input LUFS -> normalized output), and gate on the measured result (fail loudly and honestly when unmeasurable — fail-closed, never assume)
- [ ] Verify and record sample rate, codec properties, frame rate, and resolution from the ARTIFACT's real ffprobe inspection per RenderRecord; assert the brand Reel is 9:16 and the long-form 1920x1080
- [ ] Replace the flat-plate 2 fps visual claim where it is used as rehearsal evidence: keep placeholder visuals explicitly LABELED `placeholder` (Rule 3) in the rehearsal, but do not present them as finished creative output
- [ ] Fix `brand_reel` in the 1+2+1 smoke package to 9:16 and prove one complete 1 long-form + 2 content Shorts + 1 brand promo package renders with only real FFmpeg/espeak inputs inside the sandbox
- [ ] Extend the completeness gate / QC contract doc with the new accept criteria and update the rehearsal docs (R7)

## Non-goals

Real licensed music/BGM sourcing (#36-adjacent), platform-specific encoder profiles, publishing, SEO. Creative visuals remain an adapter-task, not this Gate's concern; this Gate makes technical conformance MEASURED.

## Verification

npm test / lint / verify green + the rehearsal passing the new measured QC locally (real ffmpeg/espeak sandbox), CI pass on the PR head.
